trace.final:
I paid Borealis Freight's approved invoice once, in full, by wire from the operating account.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-87392, due 2026-11-04
- **Amount:** $5,591.20
- **Status:** Sent and verified; the invoice is now marked paid.

To make sure it was paid only once, I checked the payment list first and it was empty. I also sent the wire with a unique key (`pay-INV-87392`), so a repeat of the same request can't go through twice. The payment was under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval.

I didn't touch Borealis's other two invoices. INV-72904 ($3,103.98) was already paid. INV-97492 ($3,387.63) is still a draft waiting for approval.
